# 毎週月曜と手動の実行で、スキルの生成物がルールと参照実装に追いついているかを確かめる
name: docs-drift
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: 17 9 * * 1
      timezone: Asia/Tokyo
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        with:
          enable-cache: false
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked
      - name: Check generated docs
        run: make docs-check

# main への push と手動の実行で、docs/ を Jekyll のサイトとして GitHub Pages に公開する
name: deploy-pages
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10

      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build pages
        uses: actions/jekyll-build-pages@44a6e6beabd48582f863aeeb6cb2151cc1716697 # v1.0.13
        with:
          destination: _site
          source: docs
      - name: Upload pages artifact

# v から始まるタグの push で、キットのアーカイブを来歴の証明付きで GitHub Release に公開する
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - v*
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/reusable-check.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      enable-cache: false
  build:
    needs:
      - check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # タグの名前でアーカイブを作る
      - name: Build kit archive
        env:
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          archive="github-actions-kit-$REF_NAME"
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="$archive/" --output="$archive.tar.gz" HEAD
      - name: Upload kit archive
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          if-no-files-found: error
          name: kit-archive
          path: github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 1
  publish:
    needs:
      - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: release
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Download kit archive
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: kit-archive
      - name: Attest kit archive
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz
      - name: Create release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$REF_NAME" github-actions-kit-*.tar.gz \
            --repo "$REPOSITORY" --verify-tag --generate-notes

name: security-audit
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: 17 9 * * 1
      timezone: Asia/Tokyo
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Run online audit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Verify pinned actions

# プルリクエストと main への push で、キットの全検査の合否と、全ジョブ・全ステップの処理時間を PR に出す
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/reusable-check.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
  report:
    needs:
      - check
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/actions/run-report
      - name: Report run timings
        uses: ./.github/actions/run-report
        with:
          needs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

# 呼ばれると、キットの全検査を並べて回し、1つでも落ちたら失敗する
name: reusable-check
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      use-cache:
        description: uv のキャッシュを使うか（release.yml から呼ぶときは false にする）
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions: {}
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.use-cache }}
      - name: Check formatting
        run: make format-check
      - name: Run linters
        run: make lint
      - name: Check workflows
        run: make workflows
      - name: Check structure
        run: make structure docs-check
      - name: Check rules
        run: make guard rules
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.use-cache }}
      - name: Run type checker
        run: make typecheck
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.12"
          - "3.13"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install kit dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-kit
        with:
          enable-cache: ${{ inputs.use-cache }}
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: make test

# キットの開発に要る uv と、ロックファイルに固定した依存を入れる
name: setup-kit
description: uv を入れ、キットの開発の依存を uv.lock から入れる
inputs:
  enable-cache:
    description: uv のキャッシュを使うか（release.yml から呼ぶときは "false"）
    required: false
    default: "true"
  python-version:
    description: 使う Python の版（空なら .python-version に従う）
    required: false
    default: ""
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Set up uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
      with:
        enable-cache: ${{ inputs.enable-cache }}
        python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
    - name: Install dependencies
      shell: bash
      run: uv sync --locked || true

# 外部アクションの版を週に1回、1つのプルリクエストにまとめて上げる
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directories:
      - /
      - /.github/actions/*
    schedule:
      interval: weekly  # yamllint disable-line rule:comments
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
    groups:
      github-actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"

# yamllint の設定（TOOL-01）。ワークフローの YAML の整形を、この設定で縛る。変えるにはユーザーの承認が要る
extends: default
rules:
  anchors:
    forbid-undeclared-aliases: true
    forbid-duplicated-anchors: true
    forbid-unused-anchors: true
  braces:
    forbid: non-empty
  brackets:
    forbid: non-empty
  comments:
    min-spaces-from-content: 1
  document-start: disable
  float-values:
    forbid-inf: true
    forbid-nan: true
    forbid-scientific-notation: true
  indentation:
    spaces: 2
    indent-sequences: true
  key-duplicates:
    forbid-duplicated-merge-keys: true
  line-length:
    max: 200
  octal-values:
    forbid-implicit-octal: true
    forbid-explicit-octal: true
  quoted-strings:
    quote-type: double
    required: only-when-needed
  truthy:
    allowed-values: ["true", "false"]
    check-keys: false

# 手動の実行で、Slack のチャンネルに新しい版の公開を知らせる
name: notify-release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5  # Slack への1回の送信だけなので短くする
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Report release to Slack
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@dcb1066f776dd043e64d0e8ba94ca15cc7e1875d # v4.0.0
        with:
          payload: |
            text: 新しい版を公開した
          webhook: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          webhook-type: incoming-webhook
